ops.title: Subprocess resource monitor: design B decisions and deferred CPU hunk 1c
ops.body:
Resource monitor (branch perf/subprocess-resource-guard): one shared ticker in capt-hookd registers sessions from verified hook events (anchor walked from the authenticated peer pid; claimed ClientPPID must lie on the walk), samples natively, and dispatches a host-only ResourcePressure event (warn/judge/escalate). The host advances past warn only on a stdout ack decoding to exactly {"decision": "proceed"}; every other outcome excludes the child (fail closed). Judge and escalate are fire-and-forget; Python owns screening, ownership proof, notices, the small-tier judge, identity revalidation and the single targeted SIGTERM; SIGKILL only after Python's own recorded SIGTERM. Settings parity: internal/wireproto/resource.json → captain_hook/resource_defaults.py (hatch_build). Sample cadence is daemon-wide; per-session env sets thresholds/grace/caps. Documented limit: the judge CLI inherits the daemon worker env minus hook-whitelisted keys.

CPU fast-follow (branch perf/cpu-fast-follow + cc-transcript perf/registry-interning): hunk 1c (client omits tool_registry) is deferred to the typed codec/transport phase because the host-request schema requires the field and forbids extras on both the Python-generated and Go copies. Memo hits skip the foreground-deadline raise and owner liveness by design (no I/O). Rust register_tool_registry no longer runs admission reservation for an already-interned registry (error ordering change, document in PR).
